name: BACH_0299
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 [F1] with single-class set and full model agreement; confirm invasion before releasing drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strong invasive score (ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94% OOD [F6] | Passes QC, atypical appearance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Backbones match each other |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (79%–84%) [F5] | Nearest references are invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Strongest score (+2.44 contribution); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 6, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+1.03 contribution); 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.82 contribution); 18/20 AI spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 5, 7) · context · CV 0.67 (95th percentile) [F8]; mean 45.8 µm² (0th percentile) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score more than random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable Frequent mitotic figures (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical appearance (94% OOD percentile) or benign mimic BACH_0284 (69% similarity) misleads the classifier.
- Small nuclei (45.8 µm²) and lymphocytes (region 11) reflect duct-confined in situ cells (1%), not stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5**: Confirm stromal invasion (83 neoplastic nuclei in region 5) for drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 8, 10**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism and size variation (CV 0.67, mean 45.8 µm²).
3. **Regions 6, 7, 10, 11**: Manually check mitoses (unreliable concept) and duct-confined cells or lymphocytes in region 11.
